pollster_accuracy.method: Final head-to-head national poll per pollster ending Oct 20 - Election Day each year; absolute error of D-R margin vs certified popular-vote margin; pollsters must appear in all three years; ranked by mean absolute error.
pollster_accuracy.rule: Included only if the final national poll was within 2.0 points of the certified popular-vote margin in each of 2016, 2020 and 2024 AND showed the popular-vote winner ahead in each year.
